# toProperCase

<link-summary>Capitalises the first letter of every word and lowers the rest.</link-summary>

<web-summary>toProperCase() — Capitalises the first letter of every word and lowers the rest. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/string</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function toProperCase(value: string, options: ToProperCaseOptions = {}): string;
```

Word boundaries are those of a regular expression, so `"hello WORLD"` becomes `"Hello World"`. Punctuation and separators are left exactly where they were.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                  | Description                                                                  |
| :---------------------------- | :-------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                       | `string`              | The string to convert. It must not be empty.                                 |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `ToProperCaseOptions` | `trim` trims the string and collapses runs of whitespace into single spaces. |

## Returns

`string` — the converted string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
toProperCase("hello WORLD"); // => "Hello World"
```
